options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_html:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_fr:
Un système qui peut déplacer la progression plus tôt, pour essayer et empêcher le joueur de se coincer et s'ennuyer tôt.

Un réglage plus bas signifie qu'il reste coincé. Un réglage plus élevé signifie moins se coincer.

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.
options.doc_html:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

Full: ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

Minimal: ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.
options.doc_fr:
Définir les règles d'accessibilité de vos objets/emplacements.

**Full:** s'assurer que tout peut être atteint et acquis.

**Minimal:** s'assurer que ce qui est nécessaire pour atteindre votre objectif peut être acquis.

options.name: Traverse Mode
options.doc:
Choose how you want to Traverse the World
Normal: no changes to the game
Random Transition: Map transition like Morose -> Forest are randomized
Random Teleporter: No Map transition and only through Teleport possible
options.doc_fr:
Choisissez comment vous voulez Traverser le monde
Normal: pas de changement dans le jeu
Random Transition: Transition des cartes comme Morose -> La forêt est randomisée Téléporteur aléatoire : aucune transition cartographique et seulement via Téléport possible

options.name: Open Morose (not in use)
options.doc: Depricated Option

options.name: Randomize Knife
options.doc: If set to false, you receive the Knife as Starting Item

options.name: Randomize Orb
options.doc: If set to false, you receive the Orb as Starting item

options.name: Randomized Item Upgrades
options.doc:
If set to true, all Item upgrades in the Crafting Menu have random new Item
and the Item upgrades are in a different Location i.e. on the overworld.

options.name: Randomize Money
options.doc: Randomize each Money Block

options.name: Randomize Mananite
options.doc: Randomize each Source of Mananite Shards

options.name: Randomize Magitite
options.doc: Randomize each Source of Magitite Shards

options.name: Chaos mode
options.doc:
Item Chaos rerolls every non Progressive Item into a new Item.
The new Item can be any type of Item as long as it can be stacked,
this include even Item like High Jump.

options.name: Unlock Celia and Sable
options.doc: Unlocks Celia and Sable mode

options.name: traps_percent
options.doc:
Sets the percent amount of filler / useful items that are replaced by Traps.
When played without randomized money a value around 25% is recommended.

options.name: Goal Type
options.doc: Determines the requirement type to fight the Final Boss
options.doc_fr: Détermine le type d'exigence pour combattre le boss final

options.name: magitite_amount
options.doc: Sets the amount of findable yellow shards when they are randomized

options.name: mananite_amount
options.doc: Sets the amount of findable purple shards when they are randomized

options.name: gear_count
options.doc: The Amount of Gears found in the Game

options.name: goal_count
options.doc:
The Amount of Gears required to Finish the Game
If this Number is greater than Gear count,
it is reduced to the Number of Gear count

options.name: Walljump Tricks
options.doc:
Using Items to manipulate Movementspeed,
for the Rabbit variants 200% Item use speed is required

options.name: Backflip
options.doc: Backflip enables a early mini double jump
options.doc_fr: Backflip permet un mini-double saut précoce

options.name: Ceiling kick
options.doc: Use a dropkick against a ceiling to reverse movement Direction

options.name: Hidden Paths
options.doc: Consider Hidden Paths in Free Roam for the logic
options.doc_fr: Considérez les chemins cachés dans l'itinérance libre pour la logique

options.name: Dream Keeper entrance skip
options.doc: Skip Dreamkeeper wind with Dropkicks and Strong Air Up

options.name: Barrier Skip
options.doc: Skip Cutscene Barriers with Airdash (easy) or Slide (hard) and requires 60 fps lock

options.name: ADCKick
options.doc:
Enter Gallery of Souls with a a precise Airdash into Walljump from Ceiling pixel 
(very hard)
options.doc_fr: Entrez dans Galerie des âmes avec un Airdash précis dans Walljump de plafond pixel (très dur)

options.name: Super Bosses
